news.item: I received the “HUAWEI” Scholarship, Nanjing University.

Our project “Monitoring Your Vital Signs Anytime and Anywhere Using Smartphones” won the Outstanding Achievement in Innovation at the 51st International Exhibition of Inventions Geneva (Top 0.1–0.5%, First Student Author).
Our paper on general speech reconstruction using a smartphone’s built-in accelerometer was accepted at MobiCom 2026 (CCF-A, acceptance rate 14%).
Our mmWave-based acoustic eavesdropping paper was accepted at UbiComp / IMWUT 2026 (CCF-A).
Serving as Poster Chair Member on the Executive Committee of ACM UbiComp 2026.
Selected for the Postgraduate Research & Practice Innovation Program of Jiangsu Province.
